note:
Only figures that were actually published are here. No price is invented — a missing number is honest, a plausible fabricated one is the failure this project exists to avoid.

COVERAGE IS THIN THIS WEEK AND THAT IS A TIMING PROBLEM, NOT A SOURCING ONE. This file was written on 31 August, four days before the deadline. Fantasy Football Scout publish their captaincy poll, their clean-sheet odds and their projected-goals table on or near deadline day, and none of the three exists for Gameweek 3 yet — their Gameweek 3 clean-sheet piece is listed as coming soon. So `captain_share` is empty, `clean_sheet_probability` carries bands rather than percentages, and `projected_goals` is empty. Every one of those should be filled on the deadline-day refresh.

`anytime_goalscorer: null` means "not found", never "no chance".
